raw_segments.text: Goodbye, old man. Mother expects me back to dinner, he said quickly. What a pity I did
not tell her. She will be dreadfully anxious. But after dinner I'll come back to you for
the whole day, for the whole evening, and I'll tell you all sorts of things, all sorts
of things. And I'll bring Perezven, but now I will take him with me, because he will
begin to howl when I am away and bother you. Goodbye.
